summary: Several changes make document and window cleanup more timely and keep page features in sync: 2D canvas contexts release their buffers as a window closes, and a document’s `<input>.labels` updates when its associated label changes. The work also completes `CSSTransformValue` in the CSS Typed OM, improves custom-element registry cleanup, and tightens how content policies, Content Security Policy (CSP), and connection allowlists are handled.
